editorial:
Imagine marrying someone you aren't even attracted to just because you think they'll be a safe and loyal spouse. That is exactly what Paul does. He picks the plain sister, Christine, thinking he is being smart. But then a bad car crash leaves him stuck in bed, and suddenly his boring life feels like a prison. Things get wild when the gorgeous sister, Martine, shows up. Paul decides he wants her, but he has to get rid of all her other boyfriends first. It is a dark, twisted comedy that feels like a game of cat and mouse where the main guy is totally delusional.

You will love how the movie balances the funny moments with the creepy parts. The acting is great, especially the way Paul tries to act innocent while doing terrible things. It might feel a bit slow in some spots, but the shocks keep you interested. If you enjoy movies about people getting what they deserve, you should definitely check this one out. You can find it by renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends who like weird stories.
endingExplained: The story ends with a big shock. Paul thinks he is the smartest person in the room, but he is actually being played. It turns out Christine is not the boring, clueless wife he thought she was. She knows everything he has been doing. In the final twist, the sisters work together to trap him. Paul ends up losing everything because he underestimated the woman he married, proving that being safe is not the same as being smart.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and twists.
